description: Living-dataset release cadence (COVERAGE-AUDIT N26; ROADMAP.md 'Ongoing — Living dataset'). The end state is ANNUAL citable DOI snapshots, but only the machinery (chief/91's deterministic packaging + release-asset path, merged) and the FIRST snapshot (chief/102, proposed) are tasklisted — the recurring cadence is prose owned by nothing. Wire the scheduled annual release path onto the shipped 91/102 machinery: a scheduled job (CI cron or documented scheduler) that packages the current corpus, mints/records the year's DOI via the 102 path (idempotent per corpus version — an unchanged corpus does not mint a duplicate DOI), and surfaces the new snapshot on the living-dataset/citation routes. Small (S) — this is wiring + docs + tests over existing machinery, not new packaging code. Note: the DOI-mint step itself may need credentials/egress (Zenodo/DataCite); keep the scheduled job's CI-verifiable half hermetic and the mint step documented as the credentialed handoff, as 102 does.

userStories.title: Scheduled annual DOI release wired onto the 91/102 machinery
userStories.description: A scheduled path that runs the deterministic packaging + DOI-mint/record flow on an annual cadence and exposes the result on the citation surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: A scheduled job (e.g. a cron-triggered GitHub Actions workflow, or an equivalently documented scheduler) runs the 91 packaging script against the current corpus and drives the 102 DOI-mint/record path, appending the new version + DOI + sha256 to the release manifest; the cadence and any credentialed/egress-requiring step (Zenodo/DataCite mint) are documented in docs/artifact-versioning.md as the handoff, and the job is idempotent — re-running against an unchanged corpus version mints no duplicate DOI and changes nothing.

The living-dataset/citation surfaces (services/api living_dataset/_release routers) serve the LATEST snapshot's DOI + citation and retain the prior years' entries, covered by a test over a multi-entry release-manifest fixture (no live mint required in CI).

The applicable gates pass (`uv run --all-packages pytest -q services/api/tests`, `uv run --all-packages ruff check services/api`, `uv run --directory services/api --all-packages mypy`); `.chief/verify.sh` passes and the workflow/manifest JSON-YAML parse.
